enlarge.empty: Drop a picture, then press Enlarge.
simple.empty: The picture will show up here.
enlarge.drop.choose: Drop a picture or click to choose
enlarge.model.help: The registered model id. A picture preset writes one of these.
enlarge.scale.help: How much larger the picture becomes.
enlarge.tile.help: How much of the picture the GPU handles at once. Automatic picks from the free memory. A neural model runs on TensorRT. CUDA is used when that engine does not build.
enlarge.double.help: On applies the size twice. Resulting size is the factor.
enlarge.factor.help: How many times larger the saved picture is.
enlarge.format.help: AVIF, JPEG XL, and WebP are the usual files. JPEG and HEIC are older choices.
enlarge.quality.help: How much detail to keep, from 1 to 100. Picture presets use 60.
enlarge.lossless.help: On keeps every detail in a JPEG XL file and ignores the quality number.
enlarge.gpu.help: Which graphics card does the work. Automatic uses the one the suite already chose.
enlarge.gpu.warn: This graphics card can run the job, with less room to spare.
enlarge.beside.help: On saves beside the original. Off uses the folder below.
enlarge.output_dir.help: Used when Next to the picture is off.
enlarge.custom_models.help: An extra folder of model files.
enlarge.shared_models.help: The suite folder that holds downloaded models.
enlarge.licence.help: The licence of the selected model.
enlarge.error.missing: That file is not on this computer.
enlarge.error.models: The models are not on this computer yet. Use Manage models.
enlarge.about.title: About
enlarge.models.title: Manage models
enlarge.models.hint: Check the selected model, or open the shared model manager. Removing weights asks first.
enlarge.long_side.help: Off uses the size above. A number picks 2× or 4×, then fits this length.
enlarge.batch.title: Batch
enlarge.batch.hint: Add still images, or a folder of them. Video files are skipped. The size, file type, and model come from the main screen.
enlarge.batch.restored: A previous queue was restored. Run continues the unfinished images.
enlarge.batch.engine: A neural model runs on TensorRT. CUDA is used when that engine does not build.
enlarge.compare.title: Compare
enlarge.compare.empty: Open a picture first. The result appears here after Enlarge finishes.
enlarge.compare.placeholder:
Enlarge to compare before and after.
Drag the divider. Scroll to zoom.

enlarge.credits.registry: The models below are read from the registry.
enlarge.credits.ccby: CC-BY models — credit is required when these weights are used.
enlarge.credits.other: Other registered models use Apache-2.0 or BSD-3-Clause. Non-commercial weights are rejected and do not appear here.
